p.heading: Winter break: New Year's with Pop Pop

c: Russ "Pop Pop" Anderau lives in Belmont, NC (Gaston County, just west of Charlotte). Plan to leave Sat Dec 26 and head home Sat Jan 2 or Sun Jan 3. That leaves a rest day before BPS and Nicole go back Tue Jan 5; Finn goes back Wed Jan 6.

rows.title: Straight through Sat Dec 26 for Christmas Town's last night
rows.detail: McAdenville's free lights, 4 miles from Belmont, run Dec 1–26 only, 5:30–10pm. Leave early to get there before 10.

rows.title: Split it: Savannah Sat night, Belmont Sun Dec 27
rows.detail: Savannah is 272 mi from home and 256 mi to Belmont, almost exactly halfway. You miss Christmas Town but get an easy walk in Forsyth Park.

rows.title: Charleston stop on the way back
rows.detail: 212 mi from Belmont. Waterfront Park, the Pineapple Fountain and the Battery are free. Fort Sumter is closed New Year's Day, so go Jan 2.

Sat Jul 24 – Thu Jul 29 near Boone (5 nights), then Jul 29–31 at Pop Pop's (89 mi away)
